task.description:
Produce a design artefact for API-10 (Rate limiting) at src/design/api-rate-limit.md.

API-10 requires:
- Per-token rate limiting using a sliding-window counter (in-memory)
- Default limit: 1,000 requests per 1-minute window
- Per-token override: configurable (e.g. via a config map or environment variable)
- Requests exceeding the limit receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header (seconds until window resets)
- Requests that receive HTTP 429 MUST NOT be processed (middleware must short-circuit before handler)
- Token with no configured limit uses the global default
- Retry-After: 0 when the window has just reset

Dependency: API-08 (Bearer token auth) is RELEASED. The token identity (token_id or token hash) is already available after auth middleware runs. Rate limiting runs AFTER auth (only authenticated requests are counted).

Design must include:
1. The in-memory data structure for the sliding window counter (e.g. a hash map keyed by token_id with an array of timestamps or a bucket approach)
2. Module interface: public types, public functions, error types
3. Thread-safety strategy (the HTTP server may handle concurrent requests)
4. Where per-token limit overrides are stored/read (suggest env vars like BPM_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT and BPM_RATE_LIMIT_TOKEN_<ID>)
5. Integration: how the rate limit middleware plugs into the middleware chain in src/main.zig or src/api/api_mod.zig
6. The HTTP 429 response shape (RFC 9457 problem detail, Retry-After header)

Per the backend developer guide §6 format: include Module name, Zig source files, Public types, Public functions, Error types, and Integration notes.
acceptance_criteria: Module name and Zig file paths are specified
All public types and functions are defined with signatures
Middleware chain integration point is specified
Per-token limit override mechanism is documented

result.summary: Design artefact for API-10 (rate limiting) produced at src/design/api-rate-limit.md. Covers module rate_limit (src/api/middleware/rate_limit.zig): fixed-bucket sliding-window algorithm, public types (TokenBucket, RateLimitedInfo, RateLimitResult), public functions (init, deinit, check), error set (RateLimitError), Mutex-based thread-safety, env-var-driven per-token limit overrides (BPM_RATE_LIMIT_DEFAULT, BPM_RATE_LIMIT_TOKEN_{token_id}), HTTP 429 / Retry-After response shape, AuthContext.token_id extension, and middleware chain integration notes.
